absorptions.upstream_title: Refresh managed MCP requirements for active threads (#35213)
absorptions.semantic_mapping: Each loaded thread now receives a typed current Config snapshot whose MCP servers, managed requirements, plugin requirements, OAuth store mode, and Hepta elicitation authority are refreshed together while the thread model remains unchanged.
non_claims: The thread-start MCP invalidation window deferred in R9 is not closed by loaded-thread refresh.

absorptions.upstream_title: Refresh MCP config independently across threads (#35216)
absorptions.semantic_mapping: The pre-existing per-thread best-effort refresh loop isolates send failures; the R10 transplant retains that isolation while widening the refreshed snapshot to managed requirements.
non_claims: No claim is made that failed or unloaded threads are durably queued for later refresh.

absorptions.upstream_title: Route MCP auth discovery through runtime HTTP clients (#35239)
absorptions.semantic_mapping: OAuth discovery and auth status now resolve the same server placement and runtime HTTP client configuration used by the MCP runtime across app-server, CLI, connectors, plugins, skill dependencies, startup, and refresh paths.
non_claims: Runtime proxy credentials remain governed by their existing configuration and secret providers.

absorptions.upstream_title: Harden network approval cancellation and concurrency (#35267)
absorptions.semantic_mapping: Pending approvals bind host, protocol, port, turn, and execution; owner drop denies waiters and cancels the owning execution; allow and deny cache mutation is serialized under the effective policy callback.
non_claims: The approval key does not claim identity beyond the current turn and execution identifiers.

absorptions.upstream_title: Skip plugin MCP filtering when no allowlists are configured (#35280)
absorptions.semantic_mapping: Plugin MCP servers are preserved when no allowlist layer is configured, while an explicitly configured empty allowlist remains a deny-all boundary.
non_claims: An explicit empty allowlist is not treated as absence and still denies every plugin MCP server.

deferrals.reason: Hepta does not yet expose a paginated remote-thread fork surface with a canonical cursor and history ownership contract.
missing_prerequisites: fork ownership and transcript consistency tests
non_claims: No paginated thread-fork behavior is absorbed.

deferrals.upstream_title: Avoid persisting non-local threads for hook transcripts (#35221)
deferrals.reason: The local hook transcript path lacks a typed local-versus-remote thread provenance boundary that can be proven before persistence.
missing_prerequisites: negative persistence tests for non-local transcripts
non_claims: Non-local hook transcripts are not claimed to be persistence-free.

deferrals.reason: No local product entitlement requirement or authoritative plan mapping has been approved for ent26.
non_claims: Hepta does not advertise ent26 plan support.

deferrals.upstream_title: Support ephemeral forks of paginated threads (#35251)
deferrals.reason: This leaf depends on the deferred paginated fork cursor, history, and provenance contracts.
non_claims: No ephemeral paginated fork behavior is exposed.

deferrals.reason: Publishing is an external write and requires a workspace capability owner, reviewer policy, and receipt model absent locally.
non_claims: No workspace plugin publication capability is advertised.

deferrals.upstream_title: Propagate remote plugin IDs to skill metadata (#35261)
deferrals.reason: The local tree lacks the ext/skills provider and canonical remote plugin identity chain required to prevent stale or forged metadata.
non_claims: Remote plugin IDs are not propagated into local skill metadata.

deferrals.upstream_title: Track remote plugin IDs in skill invocation analytics (#35262)
deferrals.reason: Analytics must consume the same canonical identity as skill invocation and therefore follows the deferred metadata identity chain.
non_claims: Invocation analytics do not claim remote plugin attribution.

deferrals.reason: Signing requires approved release identities, secret custody, and a publication pipeline; this task does not authorize release operations.
missing_prerequisites: secret custody and CI signing policy
non_claims: No helper binary was signed or published.

deferrals.upstream_title: Allow disabling the in-process code-mode host fallback (#35266)
deferrals.reason: The local code-mode fallback surface needs an ingress inventory and compatibility decision before changing availability semantics.
non_claims: The in-process fallback is not claimed to be disableable under the upstream contract.

deferrals.upstream_title: Include code-mode tool names in Responses Lite metadata (#35271)
deferrals.reason: Metadata exposure depends on the unresolved code-mode host policy and requires a bounded disclosure review.
non_claims: Responses Lite metadata does not claim upstream code-mode tool-name parity.

deferrals.reason: The local remote execution path needs a privacy-reviewed trace schema and stable connection lifecycle before importing observability fields.
non_claims: No remote exec-server connection trace parity is claimed.
